findings.text: blocking: the after_suite arm is unreadable - the log shows 31 dots then EXIT=124 with no pytest summary line, and the manifest records completed=false, so done-when item 3 (both suite arms recorded) is not met and the added-failure delta is unmeasured; rerun the head arm under a longer bound or with the one slow real-store test excluded by an explicit -m selection.

blocking: the recorded baseline_suite log_path points at a file whose content is a later deselected rerun (31 passes, EXIT=0, no summary), which contradicts the baseline_suite JSON it is cited for (failure_count 1, test_coverage.py::test_limited_slice_is_read_only_when_coverage_is_certified); a reader opening the named log cannot corroborate the recorded numbers, so the baseline arm is not durably evidenced even though the manifest notes the overwrite.

follow-on: crosscheck.py reads trace records through read_convention but never calls check_trace_record, and probe_read.py:15 does the same, so the goal's 'rather than reading it' holds only at the guard API - the actual field-swap reader still reads a record whose grid contradicts its declared polarity; the goal text asks nova to catch the contradiction on the read path.

follow-on: guard_slice passes boundary_points(view), which returns None when a slice carries neither x-points nor an outline, into check_axis_boundary_sign, whose _boundary_value at orientation.py:81 does np.asarray(None, float).reshape(-1, 2) and raises a bare ValueError, not ReferenceSignError; a slice with no boundary would crash the driver instead of being recorded with a reason.

follow-on: grid_value adds a 25-line bilinear sampler for a rectilinear psi grid, a capability the repository already owns in scripts/prototypes/efit_field_swap/spline_field.py:25 (TraceSplineField, the record's own spline) and nova/equilibrium/flux_surface_geometry.py:427 (RectBivariateSpline) and nova/imas/profiles.py:300; the guard could sample through an owner instead of forking the mechanism.

item_verdicts.diff: read commit by commit (0638b6189, 1cb509d4a) against a5ebd580f; five files, 649 insertions, all inside the declared scope.
item_verdicts.done_when: the done_when names (1) refusal by orientation.py, (2) every TCV slice refused with every field-swap row unchanged, (3) both suite arms recorded; items 1 and 2 are met and shown, item 3 is half met because after_suite never reached its summary.
item_verdicts.goal: the goal is to make nova refuse, not read, a reference whose stored flux sign contradicts its declared convention; orientation.py:133 implements the check and reference_sign.py:46 drives it over the TCV store.
item_verdicts.manifest: read; it states status complete, records the guard, the 12-of-12 and 0-of-28 refusals, the 9 passing unit tests and the red negative control, and itself flags the after_suite arm as incomplete.
item_verdicts.write_paths: the source node was fenced to orientation.py, test_orientation.py, scripts/prototypes/tcv_liuqe_known_answer, and the two doc fragments; every path in the diff is inside them.

justifications.durability: test_orientation.py:88 test_negated_grid_against_its_scalars_is_refused asserts a ReferenceSignError on a negated field, which reddens when the guard is removed as the negative-control run at negative-control.log:1 shows (6 failed), so the assertion is independent of the value under test.
justifications.evidence: the driver result LIUQE_ROWS 12 REFUSED 12 and FIELD_SWAP_ROWS 28 REFUSED 0 is recorded in reference-sign.log with the per-slice spans corroborated by reference-sign-slices.json, but the required after_suite arm at after_suite.log:1 is unreadable (EXIT=124, no summary), so done-when item 3's delta is unmeasured.
justifications.fit: orientation.py:53 grid_value and the surrounding helpers follow the module's numpy/ValueError idiom and use capability-named symbols with no plan label.
justifications.goal_fidelity: orientation.py:133 adds the declared-convention grid/scalar sign check the goal names, but no existing reader reaches it: crosscheck.py:56 and probe_read.py:15 read trace records through read_convention and never call check_trace_record.
justifications.reuse: orientation.py:53 grid_value re-implements rectilinear psi interpolation already owned by scripts/prototypes/efit_field_swap/spline_field.py:25 and nova/equilibrium/flux_surface_geometry.py:427 without extending either owner.
justifications.scope_discipline: git diff a5ebd580f..1cb509d4a touches exactly the five declared paths (orientation.py, test_orientation.py, reference_sign.py, and the two doc fragments) and nothing else; the manifest's restored out-of-scope ruff-format sweep left no residual change.
